mapper.select: SELECT id, service, digest, status, created_at, last_used_at FROM service_credential WHERE digest = #{digest} AND NOT deleted
SELECT id, service, digest, status, created_at, last_used_at FROM service_credential WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
SELECT id, service, digest, status, created_at, last_used_at FROM service_credential WHERE NOT deleted AND service = #{service} ORDER BY service, id

INSERT INTO service_credential (id, service, digest, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{service}, #{digest}, 'active', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor}, false) RETURNING id, service, digest, status, created_at, last_used_at
mapper.update: UPDATE service_credential SET last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'active' AND NOT deleted
UPDATE service_credential SET status = 'disabled', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'active' AND NOT deleted
